headline: Copper Prices Fall 9% in One Week as Shanghai Supply Squeeze Settles
summary: Global copper prices dropped 9% in London over a single week following a sharp supply squeeze on the Shanghai exchange. Market participants are evaluating demand trends in China.
why: Copper is a vital industrial commodity used in manufacturing, electronics, and construction, acting as a leading macroeconomic indicator.

impacts.name: Copper Futures
impacts.why: The easing of supply constraints on the Shanghai exchange precipitated price declines.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The unwind of an acute supply tightness on the Shanghai exchange triggered a weekly price decline in international markets.
